name: Poopinteetha's Domain
source:
Experience an encounter with the Urban Legend Poopinteetha. She will visit you at 3AM if you lose as Palutena three times in a row in Super Smash Bros.
Can you survive?

[From [url=https://bagelo-masterson.itch.io/poopinteetha]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
体验与都市传奇Poopinteetha的邂逅。如果你在《任天堂明星大乱斗》中以帕鲁特娜的身份连续输掉3场，她会在凌晨3点来拜访你。
你能活下来吗？

[来自[url=https://bagelo-masterson.itch.io/poopinteetha]Itch.io[/url]]
